title: F12 · first_salary · Eighteen Thousand
lines: She had imagined this day for years. It did not feel like this.
After rent and the train pass,
there was barely enough for one gift.
She bought her grandmother a shawl. Three hundred and fifty rupees.
Dadi put it on at once.
Then she walked to the shelf, and showed it to Shiva.
My granddaughter's own money, she told him. Twice.
"My granddaughter's own money," she told him. Twice.
Ananya stood in the doorway and understood something about size.
A handful, given with love, fills more than a palace. That is sadhana.
